thread:
sam-support: Heads up — BetaMetrics just escalated: intermittent schema errors + apparent tool_result mis-association when using parallel tool calls. Correlation cID=beta-20260402-77aa. They see wrong payload types returned occasionally.

ingest-bot: [alert] 2026-04-02T08:45:12Z request cID=beta-20260402-77aa fanout_count=3 latency=1.9s

sam-support: Customer repro minimal curl below. Happening roughly 1/300 requests under moderate load (~50rps).

beta-customer-bot: POST /v1/infer
Headers: X-Correlation-ID: beta-20260402-77aa
Body:\n{\n  \"model\": \"redwood-chat-compat\",\n  \"input\": \"compare qps and run scripts\",\n  \"tool_calls\": [\n    {\"name\":\"meta_search\",\"args\":{\"q\":\"revenue\"}},\n    {\"name\":\"python_exec\",\"args\":{\"code\":\"process(rows)\"}},\n    {\"name\":\"index_lookup\",\"args\":{\"idx\":123}}\n  ],\n  \"options\":{\"parallel_tool_calls\":true}\n}\n
sam-support: Customer saw 200 but schema validation failed: \"expected MetaSearchResult, got ExecResult\" then client retried.

ryan-dev: Can you paste the exact tool_results object they got? Also any X-Req-ID from our ingress?

sam-support: Response they reported:\nHTTP/1.1 200 OK\n{\n  \"tool_results\": [\n    {\"tool\": \"meta_search\", \"result\":{\"status\":\"ok\", \"output\":{\"stdout\":\"b64:\\u003cblob\\u003e\"}}},\n    {\"tool\": \"python_exec\", \"result\":{\"status\":\"ok\", \"output\":{\"rows\": [{\"id\":42}]}}},\n    {\"tool\": \"index_lookup\", \"result\":{\"status\":\"ok\", \"output\":{\"hits\": [{\"key\":\"x\"}]}}}\n  ]\n}\n
sam-support: Notice types look shuffled: meta_search carrying exec stdout blob, index_lookup has search-like hits, etc. Customer retried so billing doubled for that session.

jess-sre: @runtime-eng can you grab runtime trace? Also need the X-Req-ID. Sam, did we get rq id from the ingress headers?

sam-support: X-Req-ID: rq_b3f7e1ac. Attached the short runtime snippet I pulled:

```
[08:45:12.100] fanout: fw-901 -> worker w-21
[08:45:12.101] fanout: fw-902 -> worker w-33
[08:45:12.101] fanout: fw-903 -> worker w-21
[08:45:12.116] worker w-21: responded id=fw-902
[08:45:12.116] worker w-33: responded id=fw-903
[08:45:12.116] merger: assign fw-901 -> slot 0
[08:45:12.116] merger: assign fw-902 -> slot 1
[08:45:12.116] merger: assign fw-903 -> slot 2
```

ryan-dev: Looks like response ids and dispatch ids crossed lines: w-21 responded with id=fw-902 even though it was dispatched fw-901 and fw-903. Suggests worker echoes back a token that might be reused or swapped.

runtime-eng: Investigating. Hypothesis: per-worker echo token is not globally unique; under high concurrency workers may have stale mapping or race in token assignment. The merger currently prefers matching by echo token and falls back to position index when tokens duplicate. That fallback is risky.

jess-sre: Immediate mitigation ideas?

runtime-eng: Short-term: enforce server-generated per-invocation UUID token (fanout_token) and require workers to echo that. Hotfix to treat fanout_token as authoritative for merge. Will canary today. ETA 2-4h for staged rollout.

ryan-dev: Also add guardrails: on token mismatch, fail the request earlier instead of silently swapping results. That will surface errors to clients but avoids wrong-type payload returns.

billing-bot: [billing] Duplicate retries detected. Ticket BT-2026-0240 opened for BetaMetrics; flagged for possible refund.

sam-support: I'll push client-side workaround: set unique per-request X-Tool-Fanout-Id and ask BetaMetrics to include tool-specific tokens in args as temporary step. Also asked them to reduce rps to <30 while we patch.

runtime-eng: Plan of record:\n- collect full trace for rq_b3f7eac and worker logs for w-21/w-33 (@runtime-eng)\n- implement hotfix to require fanout_token matching and error on mismatch (@runtime-eng)\n- add unit/integration tests for concurrent fanout token collisions (@ryan-dev)\n- SRE to run canary and monitor mis-associate rate post-fix (@jess-sre)

sam-support: Customer wants RCA within 48h. I'll keep them updated and escalate if canary shows anything odd.

ingest-bot: [note] Incident INC-2026-0433 created referencing cID=beta-20260402-77aa

sam-support: Thanks everyone. Please paste any additional trace slices here. BetaMetrics will test the header workaround in ~15m.
